text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Satsuki Sho, Biwa
Hayahide is
excited to compete with
fierce racers like
Уиннинг Тикит and
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Нарита Таисин wrestles with
the
annoyance of constantly being
dismissed due to
her small stature.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Бива Хаяхидэ notices
that
Нарита Таисин seems off and tries to
reach out to
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, the look in Нарита Таисин's
eyes
indicates that she is in no mood to
talk. She
leaves without saying a word.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
